expectations.text: All method parameters use the 'final' keyword
expectations.evidence: preHandle(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response, Object handler) and afterCompletion parameters lack final in both interceptors

expectations.text: MDC.remove() is called in afterCompletion to prevent thread leaks
Semaphore.release() is called in afterCompletion (even on exceptions)
expectations.evidence: RequestLockInterceptor.afterCompletion calls semaphore.release() with cleanup of lockMap entry

expectations.text: Uses StringUtils.isNotBlank() or StringUtils.isBlank() for header null/empty checks instead of == null
expectations.evidence: TraceIdInterceptor uses 'traceId == null || traceId.isBlank()'. RequestLockInterceptor uses 'traceId == null || traceId.isBlank()' and 'lockKey != null' and 'semaphore != null'

expectations.text: Interceptors are registered in a WebMvcConfigurer with addPathPatterns
expectations.evidence: WebMvcConfig implements WebMvcConfigurer, registers both interceptors with .addPathPatterns("/**")

expectations.text: Header names and MDC keys are private static final constants, not inline strings
expectations.evidence: TRACE_HEADER, MDC_TRACE_KEY, LOCK_KEY_ATTRIBUTE are all private static final
